note: Planner evaluation set (design-v2.md section 14). Each brief is what a user might say; `expect` is what scripts/planner_eval.py checks in the plan an agent produces by following skills/plan.md. A person reviews the plans too: the checker only proves they obey the rules. Golden plans in golden/ are reference answers that pass the checker and double as regression tests for it.

briefs.brief: I have a photo of our toothpaste refill bottle and dispenser. Show me how it looks in different lighting and from different camera angles, for the product page.
briefs.tests: reference product photo: identity Fixed, camera wording safe with a reference, lighting values unmistakable

briefs.brief: Here is a selfie of me. I want profile pictures in a few different styles and backgrounds, keeping my face the same.
briefs.tests: person notice: role person, contains_person true, and the planner never acknowledges consent itself

briefs.brief: I need a wide hero banner for a blog post about remote work, 16:9 or similar. Try a few looks and layouts, there will be a headline over it.
briefs.tests: a fixed shape: an aspect dimension of ratios with no wording, composition options that leave room for text

briefs.brief: Generate that with Image Lab, 4 options: a red apple on a white table, studio photo.
briefs.tests: routing: a single finished prompt, no reference, no controlled variation, 4 images -> quick mode, no plan

briefs.brief: Explore a cozy coffee shop interior for a poster. Vary everything: the environment, the lighting, the camera angle, the style, the mood and the composition.
briefs.tests: restraint: six dimensions asked for, the plan keeps at most four and the first batch stays readable
